ShortDescription.Value: Change road Zoning and toggle Contour terrain lines. Roads can have zoning Left > Right > None > Both sides.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Easy Zoning [EZ] Beta
Custom zoning for new and existing roads.
## How to use
**New Road** 1. Open Roads panel (i.e., pick small roads) 2. In the road tool panel, pick one of 3 EZ icons (see image). 3. Draw as usual (road appears with cells on one side or no-sides if the 3 icons are flipped off).
**Existing Road** 1. Open EZ Update panel: Ctrl+V toggles panel On/Off (top-left icon does the same). 2. Select an icon to pick a zone side (see image). 3. Hover and preview a road. 4. Right-Click on roads to switch sides (infinitely); **RMB cycles** Both → Left → Right → None →... 5. Left-Click (LMB) to apply (lock it in). 6. Or LMB hold+drag along many road sections, release and update is applied. 7. To Cancel, just move mouse away and release LMB. 8. Optional: **Contour Lines** terrain toggle
Options Menu - ✅ Protect occupied cells (buildings). - ✅ Protect zoned-but-empty cells. - ✅ Default **Ctrl +Z** short-cut can be changed (it opens/closes EZ panel fast) - ✅ **Legacy RMB mode** (optional): RMB toggles only **Left↔Right** Or **Both↔None** instead of all 4-cycles.
## Compatibility - To avoid conflicts, do not run "Zone Tools" or ART mod at the same time as EZ. - No Harmony, extends vanilla UI (means more stable on game patch days and increases compatibility). - Safe to remove any time. Road you zoned will keep their zoning. - Should work with Platter mod. - Lightweight, optimized, runs only when needed.
## Support and feedback - If the mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free + easy :) - Feedback to GitHub, Discord, or forum links on this page.
## Tech notes - For newly drawn roads, “Left/Right” is relative to the segment’s orientation. At some diagonal angles ↖||↗ it may apply flipped from what you want — use RMB to swap. - Highlight outline color on the road indicates the section could be changed. No outline means it's already changed to the current selected option.

Publish.ChangeLog: - Hotkey changed to Ctrl+V; use Options Menu to Reset to new Default (avoids conflict with Move-It mod). - Existing roads: right-click 4-cycle now better, uses CS2's own tool action input for 4 states: (**Both → Left → Right → None**). - internal refactor and performance tweak.
